# Makon Coworking

> Makon is a coworking space in central Tashkent, Uzbekistan, at 11 Lashkarbegi Street (Lashkarbegi ko'chasi, 11), in the Akai City residential complex, a 2-minute walk from Hamid Olimjon metro station. Every resident has their own dedicated desk. The website is in Uzbek, Russian and English.

## Key facts

- Name: Makon Coworking (also "Makon", "Makon kovorking", "Коворкинг Makon")
- Address: 11 Lashkarbegi Street, Akai City residential complex, 2nd floor, Tashkent, Uzbekistan
- Address in Uzbek: Toshkent, Lashkarbegi ko'chasi, 11, Akai City turar-joy majmuasi, 2-qavat
- Address in Russian: Ташкент, улица Лашкарбеги, 11, ЖК Akai City, 2 этаж
- Getting there: 2-minute walk from Hamid Olimjon metro station; parking available
- Opening hours: Monday to Saturday, 10:00–19:00; closed on Sunday
- Desks: 15, each assigned to one resident
- Included for residents: dedicated desk, computers, Wi-Fi, free printer, free personal locker, books for residents
- Phone: +998 99 070 44 41, +998 95 747 44 41
- Website: https://makoncoworking.uz/
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/makon_coworking/
- Yandex Maps: https://yandex.uz/maps/org/233840017594/
- Worka listing: https://www.worka.com/en/workplace/789b2ae9-73ab-4c14-bbdd-9d58ca59d19e

## Membership (monthly)

- Makon residents: $250 per month — dedicated desk, computers, Wi-Fi, free printer, free personal locker, books, resident community.
- Travel agents: $350 per month — everything residents get, plus a permanently assigned desk for meeting clients, a licence to operate, financial, legal and organisational services, and ready client requests. Agents work from Makon without opening their own office.
- Payment: QR code (UzQR) only; cash is not accepted.

## Additional services

SMM, marketing, and a microphone and other equipment for video and podcasts. Ask Makon for details.

## Who it is for

People who have their own work and want to grow: students, targeting specialists, freelancers, entrepreneurs and people starting out as travel agents.

## Common questions

- Where is Makon? 11 Lashkarbegi Street, Akai City residential complex, 2nd floor, Tashkent. 2 minutes on foot from Hamid Olimjon metro; parking available.
- When is it open? Every day except Sunday, 10:00–19:00.
- How much does it cost? $250 per month for Makon residents, $350 per month for travel agents.
- Can I come without a laptop? Yes. Makon has computers for residents; they are included in the membership price.
- Is the desk my own? Yes. Every resident gets a dedicated desk; there are 15 desks in total.
- How do I pay? By QR code (UzQR) from a banking app. Cash is not accepted.
- Can I visit before joining? Yes. Book a visit on the contact page (https://makoncoworking.uz/aloqa.html) or call +998 99 070 44 41.
